title: GM ATF Adapter
lead: A new transmission adapter for GM 8L90 transmissions that saves time and reduces the risk of cross-threading.
body: The adapter connects to the transmission fill port. Thread it in by hand: the threads are a small, fine pitch, and hand-threading helps prevent cross-threading.
It works with MOC's existing open hose adapter, 94640. Push the open hose over the barbed end of the new adapter and secure it with a worm gear clamp to connect to the machine.
parts: Required with 94962; secure with a worm gear clamp
source: TSB Vol 24 No 5 - 2024 New GM ATF Adapter.pdf
